_doc: Stage t (SRV-138) fixes on top of RobloxDevBot's builder data (assets/vr-mini-golf/lobby/boardwalk/models/manifest.json instances + lobby.json). Applied by tools/lobby_to_lua.py; positions are lobby-frame studs (X east, Z south, deck top Y 0).

bw_windmill_blades_216.why: (1) pivot is the hub: windmill (150,0.4,64) + hub (0,7,3.3) = (150,7.4,67.3); +0.15 Z so the 0.5-thick blades clear the tower face (>=0.15, measured by LobbyBuilder.MeasureClearance)

bw_lantern_tree_canopy_236.why: (2) mesh includes its trunks (base at local Y 0); Y 10 floated it

leaderboard_wall.why: (4) panels are on local +Z; yaw +90 turns them east

course_board.why: (5) Chase: ~(86,0,85) facing spawn so the arches show. (86,85) sits on the spawn->Lantern Grove arch sight line (both ~40 deg left of north) and hides it; (74,89) is the nearest spot facing spawn with every arch opening fully visible from the spawn eye (tools/lobby_to_lua.py --check-board)

bw_string_lights_233.why: (6) new 24-stud export spans the pier posts at X 153/177 unscaled; wire ends (bbox top, local Y 1.126) at the post tops Y 7.0

noScale.bw_practice_green: (3) keep the full 1.2-tall mesh (0.4 slab + 0.8 bumper); builder size lists the slab only

_scaleRule: only manifest 'scalable' axes are ever scaled; everything else keeps its native mesh size
